About The Job
Our team is engaged in designing, delivering and supporting Digital Tech Services for all CHC worldwide.
We deliver our solutions in a highly competitive market answering FMCH needs and sometimes supporting regulated environments (GxP, SoX and other regional or local regulations).
Our team operates in an international context, serving all markets in most of the countries around the world.
Digital Technology & Architecture organization encompasses following capabilities: Integration, Enterprise Architecture, Cloud engineering, Platform Engineering (e.g. DevOps & related framework), Platforms (ServiceNow, Observability, Chatbots, SAP, Commercial, RPA, …), Digital Workplace and more “classical” infrastructures (hosting, servers, …).
Digital Workplace & Facilities
team manages all Digital Workplace capabilities (all devices, collaboration, communication, printing, software management & deployment, …) and makes the bridge between global standards designed by global infrastructure & workplace teams and their implementation on our 60+ sites (incl. 12 plants) across the globe.
Are you passionate about delivering secure, high-performing Windows 365 Cloud PC services that enable users to work from anywhere?
Join us as a
Digital Workplace Windows 365 Expert
within our Digital Workplace & Facilities crew, with a strong focus on Windows 365 product ownership, Cloud PC lifecycle management, user experience and operational excellence. Azure Virtual Desktop knowledge is considered an optional additional skillset.
As Part Of The Device Team, You Will Own And Evolve The Windows 365 Cloud PC Capability With The Following Focus Areas
Windows 365 Product Ownership and Cloud PC lifecycle management.
Cloud PC architecture, governance, performance and cost optimization.
Microsoft Intune, Entra ID and security integration for Windows 365.
Application delivery, image management and Cloud PC user experience optimization.
Digital Employee Experience monitoring for Windows 365 users.
Automation, reporting and operational excellence.
Azure Virtual Desktop as an optional complementary skillset.
We are looking for a VDI expert, mainly on Windows 365, in our Device team to own and mature our Cloud PC service. The role is primarily focused on Windows 365 strategy, operations, governance and user experience. Azure Virtual Desktop experience is welcome but not mandatory.
Main Responsibilities
Windows 365 Product Ownership:
Own the Windows 365 Cloud PC product lifecycle, including strategy, roadmap, provisioning, operations, adoption and continuous improvement.
Define Cloud PC personas, sizing standards, entitlement models and usage policies aligned with business needs.
Manage Windows 365 provisioning policies, images, network connectivity, security baselines and device configuration through Microsoft Intune.
Optimize Windows 365 cost, license allocation, utilization and performance through regular governance and reporting.
Drive user experience improvements for Cloud PC users, including login performance, application responsiveness and supportability.
Coordinate incident, problem and change management activities with service desk, endpoint, identity, network and security teams.
Define adoption plans, operating procedures and knowledge articles for Windows 365 support teams and end users.
Cloud PC Architecture, Governance and Operations:
Define the Windows 365 service model, architecture principles, provisioning standards and Cloud PC operating model.
Create standards for Cloud PC images, device configuration, access, monitoring, resilience, support and lifecycle management.
Establish governance for capacity, licenses, consumption, performance, service quality and continuous improvement.
Own Windows 365 service KPIs, including availability, sign-in experience, performance, adoption, incident trends and user satisfaction.
Maintain clear documentation, operational runbooks, support handover materials and service reporting.
Microsoft Endpoint, Identity and Security Integration:
Integrate Windows 365 with Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Entra ID, conditional access, endpoint security and Microsoft 365 services.
Define and manage configuration profiles, security baselines, compliance policies and access controls for Cloud PCs.
Partner with identity, network, endpoint, security and application teams to ensure a secure and reliable Windows 365 service.
Support vulnerability management, patching, update rings and audit readiness for Cloud PCs.
Ensure Windows 365 aligns with Zero Trust principles and corporate security standards.
Application Delivery and User Experience:
Define application delivery approaches for Windows 365, working with application, packaging and endpoint teams.
Ensure virtual desktop images and application sets meet user persona requirements while remaining secure, supportable and optimized.
Improve user experience through monitoring, troubleshooting and optimization of sign-in times, profile behavior, network latency and application performance.
Integrate VDI services with Microsoft 365, identity, endpoint management, security tooling and ITSM processes.
Support specialized use cases such as contractors, secured access scenarios, remote workers, factory supervisors and temporary workers.
Digital Employee Experience for VDI:
Monitor and analyse end-user experience across Windows 365 Cloud PCs using available Microsoft and DEX tooling.
Create dashboards and reports covering Cloud PC health, session quality, application performance, user satisfaction and service adoption.
Develop proactive alerting, remediation and continuous improvement actions based on experience data.
Identify recurring pain points and coordinate improvements across endpoint, identity, network, security and application teams.
Automation & Integration:
Develop PowerShell and Microsoft Graph automation for Windows 365, Intune, reporting and operational activities.
Automate provisioning, configuration checks, compliance reporting, remediation and lifecycle tasks for Cloud PCs.
Create integration workflows between VDI platforms, ServiceNow, monitoring, identity and endpoint management systems.
Build operational dashboards and management reports using Power BI or equivalent reporting tools.
Product Roadmap & Stakeholder Management:
Define and maintain the Windows 365 roadmap, prioritizing Cloud PC adoption, governance, service maturity and user experience improvements.
Manage relationships with Microsoft, internal infrastructure teams, security teams, application owners and business stakeholders.
Gather requirements and prioritize enhancements from business teams, IT support, security and end users.
Conduct service reviews and communicate roadmap, risks, KPIs and improvement plans to stakeholders.
Drive adoption and change management for new VDI capabilities and operating models.
Security & Compliance:
Implement Zero Trust principles for Windows 365, including identity, conditional access, device compliance and least-privilege access.
Ensure VDI services comply with corporate security standards, GxP, SoX and applicable regional or local regulations.
Coordinate vulnerability management, patching, security baselines and audit readiness for Cloud PCs.
Define disaster recovery, resilience and business continuity requirements for critical VDI use cases.
About You
Technical background required.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field, with proven experience in international and global organizations.
Deep hands-on experience with Windows 365 Cloud PCs, including provisioning policies, Cloud PC sizing, Intune management, image strategy, monitoring and lifecycle operations.
Strong understanding of Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Entra ID, conditional access, hybrid identity, modern authentication and endpoint security baselines.
Experience designing Windows 365 personas, service models, access patterns and governance for enterprise-scale environments.
Understanding of Cloud PC image management, application delivery, update management, monitoring and user experience optimization.
Experience integrating Windows 365 with Microsoft 365, ServiceNow, monitoring platforms, security tooling and business applications.
Ability to analyse Windows 365 performance, capacity, cost, adoption and user experience metrics, and translate insights into improvement plans.
Advanced PowerShell scripting skills; experience with Microsoft Graph, Azure Automation, Logic Apps or similar orchestration tools is preferred.
Knowledge of Azure Virtual Desktop, including host pools, session hosts, application groups, scaling plans and FSLogix profile management, is optional and considered a plus.
Knowledge of security, compliance and regulated environments such as GxP, SoX, ISO or similar standards is preferred.
General.

Your primary mandate is to design and govern the
AI Context Layer

45+ data products across our Studio, Finance, and Enterprise domains

Role & Responsibilities
:
Enterprise Ontology & Semantic Governance
Multi-Domain Canonical Modeling:
Lead the rationalization and creation of cross-domain canonical models (e.g., content hierarchies, unified customer identity spines, financial ledgers) that seamlessly unify data across deeply siloed source applications.
Universal Semantic Layer Governance:
Set the technical standard and reference architecture for a universal semantic layer across
45 distinct data products

AI-Native Prototyping:
Leverage modern AI-native development environments (such as
Cursor, GitHub Copilot
) to rapidly generate, iterate, and document blueprints for complex enterprise data schemas and metadata layers.
Hands-on Proof of Concepts (PoCs):

Establish the Well-Architected Data Framework:
Define and enforce enterprise pillars for data architecture—focusing heavily on scalability, absolute data integrity, fault-tolerant schema evolution, and FinOps-driven cost optimization.
High-Performance Execution:
Ensure that semantic abstractions do not compromise physical database execution, optimizing massive, denormalized lakehouse engines for sub-second analytical and real-time AI retrieval performance.
Automated Data Contracts:
Implement and mandate automated data quality frameworks, CI/CD schema pipelines, and data contracts across domain boundaries to protect downstream AI agents from upstream changes.
Collaboration & Communication:

Work closely with business analysts & business users to understand data requirements.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior team members.

12+ years of deep data architecture and engineering experience
, with a proven trajectory of operating in a Staff, Principal, or Enterprise Architect capacity.
Scale and Scope:
Demonstrated success governing, designing, or managing large-scale data lakehouses containing
dozens of concurrent data products or domains
in production.
Platform Mastery:
Deep, expert-level architectural command of at least one major modern lakehouse ecosystem—
Snowflake
(Dynamic Tables, Cortex, Horizon),
Databricks
(Unity Catalog, Delta Live Tables), or
Microsoft Fabric
—alongside underlying cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure).
Advanced Modeling Expertise:
Absolute mastery over diverse data modeling languages and paradigms—including Relational, Dimensional (Kimball), Data Vault 2.0, and Graph/Ontological modeling frameworks.
Hands-On & AI-Augmented:
Must be highly proficient in Python, SQL, and modern AI development acceleration tools (
Cursor

Role Overview
This role is part of a broader enterprise initiative to establish a
Data Context Layer (DCL)
— a foundational capability designed to provide consistent, reusable, and scalable context across enterprise data products.
The DCL is intended to address challenges related to
data fragmentation, lack of shared semantics, and inconsistent interpretation of data across systems and products
. It establishes a unified layer for representing context, relationships, and meaning, enabling downstream products to operate with greater consistency, interoperability, and intelligence.
In addition, the DCL plays a critical role in enabling
agentic AI capabilities across the enterprise
by providing the structured context and semantic grounding required for intelligent agents to operate reliably. This includes ensuring that agent-driven workflows and decisions are based on
consistent, governed, and interpretable data context
, reducing risks associated with fragmentation, ambiguity, and lack of control.
Within this initiative, we are seeking a Senior Technical Architect to design and implement the technical foundation for an enterprise platform that enables teams to
publish, discover, and consume standardized data context through self-service
. This role is responsible for translating architecture principles into concrete technical patterns, integration designs, and implementation guidance that ensure the platform is scalable, secure, and production-ready.
The ideal candidate has strong hands-on experience in platform architecture, data systems, semantic technologies, and AI-enabled workflows. Familiarity with
ontologies, OWL, metadata-driven systems, agentic AI, prompt engineering, and context engineering
is required, as the platform must support both human and AI consumers of context.

context publishing
discovery
access control
versioning
validation
lineage and provenance
monitoring and observability

Evaluate and integrate enabling technologies such as
ontology and semantic modeling approaches
OWL/RDF stacks
knowledge graphs
semantic layers
MCP, A2A, and timbr-like technologies where relevant
Ensure the platform supports both self-service human workflows and AI/agentic consumption patterns.
Define technical requirements for deployment, scaling, security, resilience, and maintainability.
Support development teams through design reviews, implementation guidance, troubleshooting, and architecture decisions.
Ensure context services can move from development to production with robust release, testing, and operational controls.
Contribute to the design of APIs, data contracts, and integration patterns that make context reusable across the enterprise.
Help shape how the platform supports agentic AI workflows, including structured prompt context, tool access, and reliable grounding data.

Familiarity with ontologies, OWL, RDF, knowledge graphs, and semantic layer concepts.

technical designs are clear, reusable, and implementable
the platform is reliable, scalable, and production-ready
teams can build on common patterns rather than custom one-off solutions
context is delivered consistently to both applications and AI/agentic consumers
development-to-production transitions are smooth and governed
architecture decisions improve maintainability, interoperability, and adoption

Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. This role is focused on execution of USP goals to deliver quality products across the Materials portfolio. This is an India-based global role supporting Amgen's global obesity business. The Senior Manager, Data Enablement will own the data foundation that enables analytics, products, AI, and decision-making to move at the speed of the business.

Success is measured by how quickly new questions can be answered, how confidently teams trust the data they use, and how effectively the organization can scale analytics, AI-enabled solutions, and future products without data becoming the constraint.

Data Readiness Agenda & Use-Case Prioritization
Own the data readiness agenda supporting priority obesity analytics, products, AI/ML, reporting, and decision-support use cases.
Partner with analytics, product, commercial, scientific, operations, and technology teams to understand data needs before analytical work begins.

Prioritize data work based on business value, reuse potential, urgency, governance requirements, quality risk, and downstream analytical impact.

Define and maintain metadata, lineage, data dictionaries, transformation logic, ownership, refresh expectations, known limitations, and usage guidance.
Enable self-service where appropriate, while keeping controls strong enough for regulated healthcare data and sensitive business information.
Make reuse easy. Every high-value dataset should become easier for the next team to understand, trust, apply, and extend.

Translate governance requirements into practical ways of working that teams can follow without unnecessary friction or delay.
Support appropriate access management, documentation, retention expectations, vendor coordination, data-use controls, and audit readiness.

Set clear expectations for responsiveness, documentation, reuse, quality, transparency, and practical problem solving.

Title: Product Manager, Context Serving, Data Context Layer
Description:
Job Description
The Opportunity
Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.
Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
Role Overview
This role is part of a broader enterprise initiative to establish a
Data Context Layer (DCL)
— a foundational capability designed to provide consistent, reusable, and scalable context across enterprise data products.
The DCL is intended to address challenges related to
data fragmentation, lack of shared semantics, and inconsistent interpretation of data across systems and products
. It establishes a unified layer for representing context, relationships, and meaning, enabling downstream products to operate with greater consistency, interoperability, and intelligence.
In addition, the DCL plays a critical role in enabling
agentic AI capabilities across the enterprise
by providing the structured context and semantic grounding required for intelligent agents to operate reliably. This includes ensuring that agent-driven workflows and decisions are based on
consistent, governed, and interpretable data context
, reducing risks associated with fragmentation, ambiguity, and lack of control.
Within this initiative, the Associate Director – Product Manager, Context Serving. will own the
product definition, development, and evolution of core context serving capabilities
. These capabilities form the backbone for how context is consumed across multiple products and platforms, and will be central to enabling
governed, scalable, and reusable intelligent systems
.
The role operates at the intersection of
product, architecture, and enterprise platforms
, working closely with Enterprise Architecture, platform teams, and product leadership to build
enterprise-grade context capabilities that support both traditional data products and emerging AI-driven use cases
.
Role Summary
We are seeking a Product Manager to own a single, high-impact capability within our enterprise data context platform
self-service serving of standardized data context
. This role will focus on defining, building, and scaling one core capability that enables teams to publish, discover, and consume data context consistently across the enterprise.
The ideal candidate has strong product instincts, technical fluency in data/semantic systems, and experience partnering with engineering and architecture teams to deliver a platform capability from definition through production adoption. This role also requires working knowledge of
agentic AI, prompt engineering, and context engineering
concepts, particularly as they relate to delivering reliable, reusable context for AI-enabled applications.
Key Responsibilities
Own the product vision, requirements, and roadmap for the assigned capability within the context platform.
Define how the capability supports standardized, self-service serving of data context.
Partner with engineering, architecture, and governance teams to translate standards into implementable product requirements.
Ensure the capability is intuitive for users and scalable for enterprise adoption.
Define workflows for
publishing context
discovering context
consuming context through approved interfaces
validating and maintaining context quality
Collaborate with adjacent platform teams to ensure the capability integrates cleanly with broader context, metadata, and governance services.
Work with stakeholders to prioritize features, resolve tradeoffs, and drive adoption.
Define success metrics such as usage, reuse, quality, and time-to-onboard.
Support the transition of the capability from development into production, including release readiness, documentation, and operational requirements.
Help shape how the capability supports agentic AI workflows, including reliable context delivery for prompts, tools, skills, and AI assistants.
Required Qualifications
10+ years of product management experience in technical products, data platforms, or enterprise software.
Ability to work closely with engineering teams on platform or infrastructure capabilities.
Familiarity with data context, metadata, ontology, or semantic concepts.
Working knowledge of agentic AI, prompt engineering, and context engineering concepts.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Experience defining requirements for self-service or platform capabilities.
Ability to balance user needs, technical constraints, and enterprise standards.
Preferred Qualifications
Familiarity with ontologies, OWL, RDF, knowledge graphs, or semantic layers.
Exposure to MCP, A2A, Timbr, or similar context-serving technologies.
Experience with enterprise data governance, metadata management, or data catalogs.
Background in AI, analytics, or application platforms that depend on trusted context.
Familiarity with productionization concerns such as versioning, access control, observability, and lifecycle management.
Experience supporting AI systems that rely on structured prompts, tool use, and context orchestration.
Leadership Characteristics
Strong product thinker with ability to translate abstract concepts into actionable capabilities
Systems thinker who understands data as part of a connected enterprise ecosystem
Ability to balance innovation (AI/agentic capabilities) with governance and control
Collaborative leader who aligns product, architecture, engineering, and emerging AI initiatives
Execution-focused with emphasis on delivery, adoption, and enterprise scale
What Success Looks Like
Success in this role means
the capability is easy to use and clearly understood by target users
teams can self-serve standardized context without heavy manual support
the capability is reliable, governed, and production-ready
adoption grows across teams and use cases
the capability integrates smoothly into the broader platform strategy
the platform enables higher-quality agentic AI experiences through better context delivery
Who we are
We are known as Merck & Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.
What we look for
Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are among the intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today.
